_notes: Railways are excluded, so train bookings in 'travel' earn nothing; flights and hotels booked online earn 5%. Transactions under Rs 100 earn no cashback. Mapping rule (same as the agent's prompt): a merchant-specific rate is applied to a whole category only if those merchants are most of it; otherwise the base rate is kept and it's listed under _merchant_specific.
